title: Create Xtra Light
description: Create and a few QoL mods to have a Minecraft Vanilla+ experience
body:
## About Create Xtra Light (Fabric)

**Create Xtra Light** is designed for players who want to dive deep into the engineering of the **Create** mod without the lag or bloat of massive kitchen-sink modpacks. Built entirely on **Fabric** for peak performance, it preserves the classic *Vanilla+* Minecraft feel while integrating the best modern Quality-of-Life improvements.

---

### Key Features:

* **Core Engineering:** Enjoy the full, uninterrupted experience of **Create Fabric** to build automated factories, trains, and kinetic contraptions.
* **Smart Storage (QoL):** Stop wasting time sorting chests thanks to **Storage Drawers**, and carry your tools anywhere with upgradable **Sophisticated Backpacks**.
* **Seamless Navigation:** Explore your world with confidence using the fully integrated **Xaero's Minimap & World Map**.
* **Instant Recipe Lookup:** Quickly look up crafting recipes and item uses with the intuitive **Roughly Enough Items (REI)** interface.
* **Maximum Optimization:** Built on an ultra-lightweight Fabric foundation, this pack is perfect for low-end PCs or running smooth multiplayer servers with your friends.
